_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the two spawned tests that already drove run-security-auditor.sh's exit code before this file existed.

expectRed: blocks the push when the security audit returns a BLOCKED verdict
fails closed when the CLI fails and the diagnostic scan finds nothing
blocks the push via the fallback scan when the CLI times out and a secret is in the diff
blocks the push via the fallback scan when the CLI fails and a secret is in the diff
mutations.note: Shadows the `exit` builtin with a function that always exits 0 — every blocking exit in the script, whichever of the four routes reaches it (the terminal BLOCKED exit, fail_closed_no_llm_output, and the two fallback-scan branches), is defeated at once. Chosen over patching only the terminal exit because the guard has multiple independent fail-closed exits (Decision 79) and this is the one mutation that represents 'the guard never blocks', matching what code-reviewer's controls.test.mjs requires every CONTROL: red test in a suite to link to under a single `<base>-always-passes` id.

expectRed: approves the push when the security audit returns a clean APPROVED verdict
mutations.note: Forces the full-script approve branch to exit 1 instead of 0 — a clean APPROVED verdict still prints 'Push approved' but the hook blocks the push anyway.

expectRed: fails closed when the CLI fails and the diagnostic scan finds nothing
mutations.note: Forces fail_closed_no_llm_output's exit to 0 instead of 1 — a CLI failure with nothing for the diagnostic scan to find still prints the fix-the-CLI message but approves the push anyway.

mutations.find:
if [ "$ISSUES" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "[security-auditor] Found $ISSUES issue(s) in fallback scan. Push blocked."
      exit 1
    fi
mutations.replace:
if [ "$ISSUES" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "[security-auditor] Found $ISSUES issue(s) in fallback scan. Push blocked."
      exit 0
    fi
expectRed: blocks the push via the fallback scan when the CLI times out and a secret is in the diff
mutations.note: Forces the timeout branch's fallback-scan exit to 0 instead of 1 — a secret found in the diff after a CLI timeout still prints 'Found N issue(s)' but approves the push anyway.
